name: Ay Işığında Göl
scene: An elegant swan glides across a moonlit lake beneath a round moon and flowing night-sky bands.
notes: Design sheet only; target 30–40 panes. Swan uses gold/coral and sky, moon and water use midnight blue/turquoise. Generated with fox and lighthouse style references; original story_swan artwork inspected for subject. Regenerated once to simplify feather divisions and restore opaque white exterior. Visually checked: closed oval rim and closed panes, strict subject/background colour pairs. Remaining doubts: slight tonal shading persists; some feather tips are narrow, some same-colour neighbours may merge, and closely spaced joins around the eye and wing need tracing-stage review. Pane target is approximate, not a geometry audit.
